records.name: Religious Establishment
records.description: Not a single church. Constituent faiths and institutions maintain separate hierarchies and can compete while cooperating on shared political interests.

principles: The Pathfinder pantheon is real within the setting.
Worship varies by region, culture, community, institution, and individual.
There is no single supreme religious authority governing all faiths across the continent.
Religious institutions can own land, receive donations, provide charity and education, preserve records, influence ceremonies, advise rulers, and shape public expectations.
Divine spellcasters are uncommon; religious authority does not automatically follow magical ability.
The exact mechanism by which divine power is granted or mediated remains unresolved.
The exact legal relationship between religious courts and secular courts remains unresolved.
